Most of what helps me looks like nothing from the outside.

A walk with nowhere to be. A page in ink before the laptop opens. A book older than I am.

None of it photographs well. I keep doing it anyway.

reply_ideas.reply_text: Long walks and old books are the two people find strangest. Neither looks productive from the outside. Both make everything else on that list easier for me.
Writing a task down used to feel almost as good as doing it, which is how my list got so long. Curious which part of Sam's approach people here actually stuck with.
What helped me a little: giving rest a shape. A walk, a pen, a page with nothing due on it. Easier to defend to myself than doing nothing.
I lose track of time with a fountain pen and a blank page the way other people lose it to a feed. Same pull. I'm just glad it landed on something I can keep.
